[SWS_DM_00920] Configuration of the event memory size
⌈
The DM shall
provide event memories of a size according to the configuration parameter Di-
agnosticMemoryDestination.maxNumberOfEventEntries, where each single
event memory entry is to be understood as the complete data set that belongs to a DTC,
including counters, cycles, snapshot records and extended data records.
⌋
